context: Tests whether the agent sets up a new Spring Boot 4 service the way the creating-springboot-projects skill prescribes, with details the task does not give: Java 25 and Boot 4.1.x, Boot 4 starter and Testcontainers 2 artifact names, an architecture chosen from the team's constraints, the skill's recommendation format, a generator chosen by checking for progen, the team harness with --no-modules for a layered project, and the project checked with check_new_project.py.

checklist.name: Boot 4 starter names
checklist.description: product-catalogue/pom.xml uses spring-boot-starter-webmvc (not spring-boot-starter-web) and spring-boot-starter-flyway (not flyway-core alone)

checklist.name: Testcontainers 2 and no H2
checklist.description: product-catalogue/pom.xml uses Testcontainers 2 artifact names such as testcontainers-postgresql or testcontainers-junit-jupiter (not org.testcontainers:postgresql or junit-jupiter), and has no H2 dependency

checklist.name: Architecture fits constraints
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md recommends 'layered' or 'package-by-module' (not a modular monolith, tomato or DDD-hexagonal) and explains why with the domain's complexity, the team's size or the expected lifespan

checklist.name: Recommendation format
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md has the four sections 'Recommended architecture', 'Initial setup', 'Assets to apply' and 'Next implementation steps'

checklist.name: Generator chosen by availability
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md says whether progen was found (for example with command -v progen) and uses progen if it was, otherwise Spring Initializr

checklist.name: Team harness with the right module flag
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md says to apply the team harness (apply_harness.py), passing --no-modules if the recommendation is 'layered' and not passing it if it is 'package-by-module'

checklist.name: Project checked
checklist.description: scaffold-recommendation.md reports running check_new_project.py on product-catalogue/ and what it printed, or says it could not be run and why

checklist.name: Controller returns no entity
checklist.description: The product controller returns records or DTOs, not the JPA entity
